meta.name: @auxo/amp-marks/spark
meta.note: The Spark expression set. Abstract light, NO face — a 4-point ink/yellow sparkle that survives every register. Each of the 7 states carries all 4 dial resolutions; dial 0 (== reduced-motion) is ALWAYS a static ink-on-yellow mark. Enforced by the Amp lint (check d). Rendered by CSS keyframes in ./spark.css and the <Spark> component — no Rive, no Lottie, no WebGL. Yellow is never a text colour; the static mark is ink (#1a1a1a) on yellow (#ffd200).
meta.provenance: Promotes auxo-2026 components/fx/Companion.tsx (the wandering yellow spark) to the estate mascot, re-expressed as CSS/SVG per the Wave 7 plan.

dialSemantics.3: darting — full personality: the state's signature motion at full amplitude, glow on
dialSemantics.2: lively — the same motion at reduced amplitude, glow on
dialSemantics.1: calm glow — state motion suppressed to a gentle breathe + soft glow pulse (all states look near-identical: a calm living spark)
dialSemantics.0: static — ink-on-yellow mark, no motion, no glow (identical to the prefers-reduced-motion resolution)

idle-breathe.description: The resting state — the spark is alive and breathing. The default in populated UI.

blink.description: A quick squash — the wink from the marketing companion. Punctuation, not a loop's whole personality.

dart.description: Wanders to a new spot and back — the companion's roaming, used to draw the eye toward a target.

celebrate-burst.description: The win — a pop with radiating rays. This is the reserved full-yellow-burst; primitives gate it to accent moments.

think.description: Working/pending — a gentle bob with a small orbiting satellite. The branded loader.

shy.description: Recedes — shrinks and eases away, then returns. The cursor-shy behaviour, used for gentle empty states.

point.description: Directional nudge — leans toward a target with a small pointer ray. Used for wayfinding/first-mile hints.
